manifest.datasetName: Synthetic Telkom cell degradation NPM POC dataset
manifest.scenario: Cell degradation at JHB-CBD-003-B caused by transport backhaul congestion
manifest.sourceNote: Synthetic data generated for a POC because live Telkom operational data is not included.

summary.observedFacts: Accessibility fell from 99.1% baseline to 84.4%; average downlink throughput fell from 39.5 Mbps to 12.8 Mbps; 6 correlated alarms and 46 complaints occurred in the same window.
summary.aiInference: The degradation pattern is most consistent with transport backhaul congestion. Evidence includes microwave link degradation, S1-U packet loss, high transport discard counters, and a protection-path change 32 minutes before KPI deterioration.
summary.recommendation: Rollback or correct CFG-20260915-04521, verify MW-JHB-CBD-HUB-01 path health, then monitor RRC failures, PRB utilization, packet loss, and customer complaint rate for recovery.

facts: Cell JHB-CBD-003-B was detected as degraded between 2026-09-15T08:00 and 2026-09-15T14:45.
